title: Isaiah 41
paragraphs: ¹ Be still before me, you coastlands; let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come forward, then let them speak; let us together draw near for judgment. ² Who stirred up someone from the east whom victory meets at every step? He delivers up nations before him and tramples down kings; he makes them like dust with his sword, like wind-blown chaff with his bow. ³ He pursues them, passing on safely, along paths his feet have never traveled. ⁴ Who has worked this out and carried it through, calling forth each generation from the beginning? I, the LORD, am the first, and I will be with the last — I am he. ⁵ The coastlands have seen and are afraid; the ends of the earth tremble; they draw near and come.

⁶ Each one helps his neighbor and says to his brother, 'Take courage!' ⁷ The craftsman encourages the goldsmith, and the one who smooths with a hammer encourages the one who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, 'It is good,' and fastening it with nails so it will not topple. ⁸ But you, Israel, are my servant — Jacob, whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham, my friend. ⁹ I took you from the ends of the earth and called you from its farthest corners, saying to you, 'You are my servant, I have chosen you and not rejected you.' ¹⁰ Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be anxious, for I am your God. I will strengthen you, yes, I will help you — I will hold you up with my righteous right hand.

¹¹ See, all who are enraged against you will be put to shame and disgraced; those who contend with you will come to nothing and perish. ¹² You will seek them but will not find them — those who wage war against you will be utterly nothing. ¹³ For I am the LORD your God who holds your right hand and says to you, 'Do not fear; I am the one who helps you.' ¹⁴ Do not fear, you worm Jacob, you small nation of Israel; I am the one who helps you, declares the LORD — your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel. ¹⁵ See, I will make you into a sharp threshing sledge, new and with many teeth; you will thresh the mountains and crush them, and make the hills like chaff.

¹⁶ You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, the storm will scatter them. But you will rejoice in the LORD and glory in the Holy One of Israel. ¹⁷ When the poor and needy search for water and there is none, and their tongues are parched with thirst, I the LORD will answer them; I the God of Israel will not forsake them. ¹⁸ I will open rivers on the barren heights and springs in the middle of the valleys; I will turn the desert into pools of water and the dry ground into flowing springs. ¹⁹ I will plant cedars in the wilderness, along with acacias, myrtles, and olive trees; in the desert I will set junipers, firs, and pines together, ²⁰ so that all may see and know, and consider and understand together, that the hand of the LORD has done this, that the Holy One of Israel has created it.

²¹ 'Present your case,' says the LORD. 'Bring forward your strong arguments,' says the King of Jacob. ²² 'Let them bring forward and show us what will happen; let them tell us the former things, so we may reflect on them and know their outcome. Or declare to us the things to come. ²³ Tell us what is coming in the future, so we may know you are gods. Do something — good or bad — so that we may be startled and see it together. ²⁴ See, you are nothing, and your work is worthless; anyone who chooses you is detestable. ²⁵ I stirred up one from the north, and he has come — from the rising of the sun one who calls on my name — and he tramples on rulers as on mortar, like a potter treading clay.'

²⁶ Who told us this from the start, so that we might know? Who announced it beforehand, so we could say, 'He was right'? Not one of them told it, not one declared it — no one has heard a word from them. ²⁷ I was the first to say to Zion, 'Look, here they are!' and I gave Jerusalem a messenger of good news. ²⁸ When I look, there is no one — no one among them who can give counsel, no one who can answer when I ask. ²⁹ See, they are all false; their works amount to nothing; their cast images are empty wind.
